stem: A ladder must be placed beside a door used by another crew. Which control best addresses the setup hazard?
choices: Tell the worker on the ladder to listen for the door
Control the door or traffic so it cannot strike the ladder during the task
Move the ladder closer to the door so people can see it
Rely on the ladder's load rating to prevent movement
rationale: Traffic and door movement should be controlled so the ladder setup cannot be struck or destabilized.
